answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1331 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the umber. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the crystal queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The comet index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each copy needs 4 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
